title.note: What has to be chosen, as a question: 'How do we land the release date by March?'

about.note: The requirement, dependency or slip it answers, by id or artifact id

selected_option.note: The option id picked; set by the person

decision.note: The decision register id that records the choice, e.g. D-03

kind.note: Swap the capability or its provider; trade scope; change the order; use a preset or default instead of building

scope.note: What the person gives up or gains in scope

waiting.note: Time spent waiting on others, in weeks. Kept apart from effort: it does not shrink with more people

relies_on.note: Teams or capabilities this option depends on

reason.note: Why it was chosen or turned down. Required once it is rejected
